title.label: A godsend of an app though theres always room for improvement

content.label: I love this app since my voice is hard for dictation to pick and i get typos a lot. One suggestion to make this five stars is a lifetime purchase. If Wispr had that even if it’s a lot i’d consider buying it for a one time purchase rather than the monthly or annual membership, I’d bump this up to five. Still an amazing application and tool
